title: HDFC Tata Neu Infinity credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A premium Tata Neu Infinity card providing higher NeuCoins on Tata ecosystem spends, unlimited lounge access, milestone vouchers, and lifestyle perks.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Air accident cover of INR 10,000,000 is available to the primary cardholder, applicable if the cardholder sustains an air accident and suffers bodily injury resulting in death within 12 months of the accident. Emergency medical expenses cover of up to INR 1,500,000 is also available to the primary cardholder for international travel outside India, covering medical expenses arising due to bodily injury or sudden, unexpected sickness; expenses related to pre-existing illnesses are not covered. Additionally, card liability cover of up to INR 900,000 is provided to the primary cardholder.
